items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Did you ever see the letter that was written by a Monk student that was online? And you know it was just like he wrote down Monk’s observations.

ctx.x: Oh well that could be if he’s a snappy dresser. But actually you know it boils down to — I was having this conversation the other day and this is a backwards way to answer your question, as most of my answers have been. Jazz music, playing on the bandstand is supposed to be a mature conversation among equals. And it’s like oh you hear somebody say something, “Oh really,” and you comment. And it’s really high-minded in that sense. I can’t really play — I used to play second keyboards for a time behind George Duke.…
Oh I might have seen that, like if you don’t hear anything —
